source.paper_method: Band-edge shifts applied after DFT to close/align calculated Fermi sheets with quantum-oscillation data.

dogbone_hole.reason: Paper shifts dogbone-like hole sheets down by 0.11 eV.

web_electron.reason: Paper shifts web electron sheets up by 0.015 eV to maintain total carrier number.

claim_boundary: Paper-reported rigid band shifts are an empirical alignment transform, not an ab-initio prediction. Raw and aligned calculations must remain separately reportable.
